description: This file defines the WorkShiftController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and overrides the preRender method to set up a Vue component named 'work-shift-list' for rendering the UI related to work shifts.

classes.name: WorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling work shift related views and interactions within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It prepares the Vue component for the work shift list.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to initialize and set the 'work-shift-list' Vue component before rendering the view.
